For an **independent upper-upscale hotel or resort in the Caribbean and Latin America seeking conversion affiliation**, owners typically begin with the major **soft brands or collections**. These preserve more of the property’s identity than a conventional standardized flag.

### Primary candidates

| Parent company | Brand typically considered | Positioning / fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Autograph Collection** | One of the most frequently evaluated upper-upscale collection brands, particularly for distinctive full-service resorts and urban hotels. |
|  | **Tribute Portfolio** | Generally somewhat more flexible and lifestyle-oriented than Autograph; suitable for independent boutique hotels and resorts. Marriott is actively developing both brands in CALA, including conversions and all-inclusive properties. ([marriott.com](https://www.marriott.com/marriott-brands/portfolio/cala-openings?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection by Hilton** | A leading choice for upper-upscale or luxury-leaning independent hotels with strong design, food-and-beverage and sense-of-place attributes. Curio has completed numerous regional conversions, including in the Galápagos, Curaçao, Puerto Rico and the Dominican Republic. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-and-fuerte-group-hotels-to-debut-amare-cancun-adults-only-all-inclusive-resort?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** | Best suited to upper-upscale and luxury properties with a compelling history, architecture or destination story. It has a regional presence in Mexico, Panama, Uruguay and the Dominican Republic. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/UnboundAnniversaryGrowth2026?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **MGallery Collection** | A strong upper-upscale boutique option, especially where Accor has meaningful distribution and owner relationships. MGallery explicitly favors conversions and permits each property to retain its individual story. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Radisson Individuals** | A conversion-led, upper-upscale soft brand with an established CALA footprint, particularly in Colombia and Panama. Choice identifies Autograph, Curio, JdV and Tribute as its principal competitors. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/news/choice-hotels-relaunches-radisson-individuals-as-part-of-its-portfolio-of-brands-MCGUOTHASSNZBF5OUH7E7UATMTII?utm_source=openai)) |

### Additional or positioning-dependent candidates

- **Vignette Collection — IHG:** Usually considered when the property is luxury-leaning or highly experiential. IHG describes it as a conversion-friendly collection for independent luxury and lifestyle hotels; it already has an Americas presence in Lima. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai))
- **voco — IHG:** A more standardized premium conversion brand. It can be appropriate when the hotel lacks the uniqueness required by a collection brand but is capable of meeting an upper-upscale full-service product standard. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai))
- **Tapestry Collection by Hilton:** Often evaluated for properties positioned closer to upscale than upper-upscale, or where the required investment for Curio cannot be supported. Hilton has expanded Tapestry through conversions across CALA. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-wraps-2024-with-record-portfolio-and-pipeline-growth-in-the-caribbean-and-latin-america?utm_source=openai))
- **Ascend Hotel Collection — Choice:** Another flexible conversion option, but normally regarded as upscale rather than true upper-upscale. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai))
- **Registry Collection Hotels — Wyndham:** Relevant for luxury resorts, especially all-inclusive properties. Wyndham has built a meaningful Registry portfolio in Mexico, Panama, Brazil, the Dominican Republic and Jamaica. ([corporate.wyndhamhotels.com](https://corporate.wyndhamhotels.com/news-brands/registry-collection-hotels/?utm_source=openai))

### If the property is genuinely luxury

The screening set may shift upward to:

- **The Luxury Collection — Marriott**
- **Vignette Collection — IHG**
- **Emblems Collection — Accor**
- **Registry Collection Hotels — Wyndham**
- Potentially **LXR Hotels & Resorts — Hilton**

These brands generally require a stronger physical product, service model, culinary offering and capital-improvement program than a conventional upper-upscale conversion.

### Practical “first-call” shortlist

For a typical full-service, independent upper-upscale CALA property, the most common initial comparison is:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Curio Collection**
3. **Tribute Portfolio**
4. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
5. **MGallery Collection**
6. **Radisson Individuals**
7. **Vignette Collection**, if the property can credibly support luxury positioning

The ultimate fit normally depends on **market availability and territorial protection, required property-improvement-plan investment, loyalty-program contribution, franchise versus management availability, all-inclusive capability, key count, owner control and total brand-system cost**. A hotel may also evaluate a lighter membership affiliation such as Preferred Hotels & Resorts or Small Luxury Hotels of the World if retaining maximum independence is more important than obtaining a conventional chain flag.
